entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Captain Baltasar Fernandes was a colonist of Captaincy of São Vicente who led the expeditions called Bandeiras into the interior seeking gold, silver, and iron. He was the founder and one of the first settlers of Sorocaba in 1654.
